evidence_required: Three limitations of the Section 1.6 ceiling model, each with the measurement that would expose it.

marking.criterion: First limitation with a matching measurement (for example achievable vs peak rate, with GEMM or all_reduce_perf microbenchmarks)
Second limitation with a matching measurement (for example overlap, with an Nsight Systems timeline)
Third limitation with a matching measurement (for example latency, launch overhead, stragglers or contention, with per-rank timing or shared counters)

title: What the ceiling model cannot capture
